maddeler.e:
ننبعث (form VII)
# نَنْبَعِثُ (nanbaʕiṯu) /nan.ba.ʕi.θu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
# نَنْبَعِثَ (nanbaʕiṯa) /nan.ba.ʕi.θa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
# نَنْبَعِثْ (nanbaʕiṯ) /nan.ba.ʕiθ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
